reborn-0324.rationale: Current English Curse of Royal text is broad, but official Japanese Neuron Q&A supplies the operational restrictions that matter: it responds to the activation of a Spell/Trap Card (not merely activation of an already-face-up Spell/Trap effect), the activated card must target exactly 1 on-field Spell/Trap for destruction, and an effect that would destroy multiple cards is not eligible. The exact pinned Lua requires EFFECT_TYPE_ACTIVATE, a card-targeting chain with exactly one target, and CATEGORY_DESTROY for exactly one on-field Spell/Trap before allowing Curse of Royal to negate the activation and destroy the activated card. It therefore matches the authoritative ruling behavior despite the shorter current English text.

note: Script-hash-bound review resolving Curse of Royal's broad English wording through official Japanese Neuron ruling constraints.
